import os,resource; os.sched_setaffinity(0,sorted(os.sched_getaffinity(0))[:2]); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_CPU,(115,115)); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_AS,(6*1024**3,6*1024**3));
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess,sys,base64,json
for page in range(1,6):
 r=subprocess.run(['pdftoppm','-f',str(page),'-singlefile','-scale-to','1800','-png','sources/epstein-golubitsky-1993.pdf'],capture_output=True,timeout=20); assert r.returncode==0,r.stderr
 b=base64.b64encode(r.stdout).decode()
 z=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','-B',str(Path('write_lane.py').resolve()),'rendered/original-page-'+str(page)+'.png','--base64'],input=b,text=True,capture_output=True);assert z.returncode==0
 print(json.dumps({'page':page,'png':b}))
